title: Building This Portfolio with Next.js
summary: How this terminal-themed portfolio is built: Next.js App Router, server components, and a fake shell that actually navigates.
content:
This site is a Next.js App Router project styled as a CRT terminal.

The fun part is the docked terminal emulator: it is a React client component that parses bash-like commands and uses the Next.js router for `cd`.

Under the hood every page is a server component fed by typed data modules in lib/, and the only runtime-write path is the contact API appending to JSON.
